subject: Private Offer — discount cadence, reseller fee layering, and tax passthrough
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily@cloudchannel.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft PO / private offer questions: discount cadence, reseller fee layering and tax pass-through

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the ability to pin models per-environment. Procurement asked me to start a thread to capture a few specific items for the private offer before we move the draft PO to legal:

- Discount cadence: CloudChannel typically needs a 1-year list price with an annual true-up rather than a monthly adjustment. Can Redwood do upfront list price + quarterly or annual true-up?
- Reseller fee layering: our commercial model applies a reseller commission on the net invoice value. We need clarity whether channel margin is calculated off list price, discounted list, or net after platform credits.
- Tax passthrough: we need Redwood to confirm where VAT/sales tax is applied and whether taxes are added on top of the invoice or included in the line items. For compliance we also need Redwood's tax ID and an indication of whether you can include a tax break-out on the invoice.

I've attached our PO template (CloudChannel_PO_Template.pdf) and a short example of how we model commissions. Please let me know who on your side can confirm these points — procurement would like to finalize commercial terms by next week if possible.

Best,
Emily
Emily Tran
Head of Channel Operations
CloudChannel Solutions
procure@cloudchannel.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily@cloudchannel.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft PO / private offer questions: discount cadence, reseller fee layering and tax pass-through

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and I'm looping Lauren (Finance) and Karthik (Marketplace) to confirm details and finalize language for the PO: 

1) Discount cadence / true-up
- We can support a 12-month fixed list price in the private offer with an annual true-up (preferred) or quarterly true-ups if you need closer alignment. An annual true-up keeps invoicing simpler and matches most partner commitments we see.

2) Reseller fee (channel margin) calculation
- Our standard for Marketplace / Private Offer channel compensation is to calculate reseller commission off the net revenue to Redwood (i.e., list price less any platform credits but before taxes). That means commissions are taken from the invoiced amount that Redwood recognizes as revenue. We can adapt to a list-price basis for strategic partners if this is a gating item — that would typically change the economics and require explicit approval from RevOps.

3) Tax treatment
- Redwood invoices will break out tax where required by law. For US customers we typically add sales tax on top of the invoice (we do not net it into the listed subscription price). Lauren, can you confirm Redwood's tax ID and whether we can include a tax line on the PO?

Next steps: Karthik, please confirm whether the private offer needs any SKU mapping changes on GCP/Azure marketplaces for this to flow through partner commissions. Emily, if you can confirm whether CloudChannel prefers list-base commission or net-revenue commission, we can rapidly firm the numbers and send a DocuSign-ready PO. I'm attaching a first-pass pricing workbook for transparency (redwood_private_offer_draft.xlsx).

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft PO / private offer questions: discount cadence, reseller fee layering and tax pass-through

Team — forwarding CloudChannel's procurement note and my reply. TL;DR: they want guidance on whether commission is off list vs net; they prefer annual true-up; they need tax breakout and Redwood's tax ID for their AP process.

Ask:
- Lauren: can you paste Redwood's US tax ID and confirm whether we will add sales tax on top vs include in-line for the private offer? Also advise if calculating reseller commission on "net revenue to Redwood" is fine from a rev recognition and payout perspective, or if finance needs the commission to be based on list price to avoid downstream adjustments.
- Karthik: if we underspecify SKUs on the private offer (GCP / Azure) will CloudChannel still be able to receive partner credit/commission or do we need sku-level mapping? If mapping is required, what's the least-friction approach?

Notes: I'm inclined to accept net-revenue commission (cleaner for Redwood) but we can be flexible for a priority partner. If we move to list-price commission, we should limit to a short pilot window and track a true-up.

Thanks — Ben
From: Emily Tran <emily@cloudchannel.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cloudchannel.com <procure@cloudchannel.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft PO / private offer questions: discount cadence, reseller fee layering and tax pass-through

Ben/Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement discussed internally and here's where we landed: 

- Commission: CloudChannel can accept net-revenue commission, but given the size of the initial commitment we are requesting a 12% commission on initial committed spend for the first 12 months (we noted Redwood's standard 15% — 12% is our ask in exchange for committing to a 12-month consumption guarantee). We still want an annual true-up on consumption.
- True-up cadence: annual is acceptable. Please include an explicit clause for a quarter 4 true-up window so our finance team has time to reconcile partner payouts.
- Tax breakout: that works — we will need Redwood's US tax ID on the invoice and a separate line for sales tax. I'll attach our MOA stub for your legal to look at (signed_moa_stub.txt).

If you can send a DocuSign-ready PO with the 12% first-year commission and the annual true-up language, procurement will prioritize the signature. Otherwise we can accept the 15% standard but would need a higher commitment level.

Emily
Emily Tran
Head of Channel Operations
CloudChannel Solutions
procure@cloudchannel.com
